title: Bias
text: Add bias to input, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Bias} sets Offset to add to the input signal; {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Bias
params.values: Offset to add to the input signal 0.0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on
